content: Aita ete jas no hoyo tuwei nomo bona danga tafai, waha nomo muuji beele.
Ariya, Yesus no nomo disaipel muuji beele ete, nere gai-gai hauyawei nomo hogonyi adai nigou bona, no isisiwou nigai.
No benou lenigai, “Taon ete langa jas ete yafai. No Itou bona ada umugegai, fai bona fere ninau inyangaro ada isigai.
Ono gainga, aita oyo ete no taon waha langa yafagai. Saini oruwa no maidu bona, jas letugai, ‘Yame honggoro fai no ji inyabamu hiyona ono-onona. Ne ji kot langa hoyo hiyau.’
Ono wainga jas no ngasunga hoyo tuwei nomo awai. Ariya, iinga la no ninau benou isai, ‘Ji Itou boni umugei uwa, ji nere fai boni ninafe inyanga isei uwa.
Onou wa, aita oyo beha no gai-gai ji ou hiingana. Waha bona, ji edo kot langa hoyo tuwon boni. Gamaji no ji bagu gai-gai mainga wonga, ji no nomo beele oruwa isei nomo geefe hogonyi woga.’”
Ariya, Anyakaro no ege benou lewai, “Tere jas inyaba waha nomo beele isiyaha.

Onou waha adadu? Itou no nere fai-aita bagu, nomo bona hangada nigai waha, nere hoonga ooru bagu oruwa mere tunga wode waha, Itou no nere ada hoyo nigona yo? No itari bona fasadu ada hoyo nigona yo? Uwa.
Ji letigini, no fasayadu hoyo nigonbona. Ariya, saini Fai Nomo Idau mayona langa, no fai-aita bagu oula langa yafade waha, huwanyanege ngalengade yo, uwa yo, waha uronbona.”
Fai nga nononga nere Itou hauya tuware, waha nomo muuji beele.
Nere fai ila ninanege iside, nere nage nere fai tigini, ariya nere fai ila nere dorofe tigini uwa. Ariya, Yesus no muuji beele nere fai benouha bona lenigai.
“Nere fai nga nononga, hauyawei nomo bodere tempel la manare. Ete no Farisi, ete no takis tegou fai.

Ariya, Farisi waha oto bona, no nogo nomo huwanya langa benou hauyawai, ‘O Itou, ji nere fai ila dorofe uwa, waha boni ji ne hilobainga hinini. Nere yebu bode onowou tigini waha ada ono bode, aita fai bagu waha inyabamu nigi-nigide. Ariya, ji nu uwa. Ji takis tegou fai beha dorofe uwa.
Ji bori oruwa la, fati nga da urigei nomo hangada-hangadani. Onodu boni, dada oruwanga ji elegeni waha foure 10-du boni, ulate ete ne hini-hinini.’
Ariya, fai takis tegou waha baae la oto bona, ha laluwa igei tuwei nomo awai. Onodu no nogo bura wari bona lewai, ‘Itou, ne ji bonahe aau narou, ji une fai.’”

Ono wainga Yesus no lenigai, “Ji tere letigini, Saini takis tegou fai waha, gidu nomo mata langa minai la, no nogonga Itou ago langa fai tigini heigai. Ariya fai ete waha no uwa. Taate bona, fai ourwa nere nage unyinege isou wode wa, Itou no nere unyinege esenemu nagonbona. Ariya, fai nere nage unyinege esenemude waha, Itou no nere unyinege isou nagonbona.”
Yesus no magana mene-mene awa nigogunga, no bagu mayei nomo bona lewai.

Nere fai-aita bagu magana mene-mene hanigedu Yesus bagu mayane, nere magana mene-mene eeme aare nigide waha fere hanigedu mayane. Nere gau wane wa, no magana mene-mene jaulanege langa owo tafonbona. Ono wane wa, disaipel nere waha uredu bode, fai-aita bagu honggoro nigane.

Ono wanenga, Yesus no magana mene-mene yaure nigainga hinomu langa mayanenga, no nomo disaipel benou lenigai, “Tere magana mene-mene awa nigadenga, ji bagu mayode. Tere adai karu nigagu. Itou nomo huuna langa yafou waha, nere fai magana mene-mene benouha dorofe, waha nebere.
Ji tere ngalenga letigini, fai no Itou nomo huuna langa yafou nere magana mene-mene tede dorofe ada tebona wonga wa, no huwanya langa goyei nomo edo uwa. Gai uwanga uwa.”
Mora bagu dada baingaro waha, no Yesus ngare beele hayare.
Mora bagu ete no Yesus isoki tuwai, “Isisi higigou fai hilobainga, ji adadu onodu boni agefe auma gai-gai yafou hilobainga toni?”
Ono wainga, Yesus no letuwai, “Ne taate boni ji fai hilobainga hini? Itou no nogonga hilobainga.

Ne nuuni beele amina isene, ‘Tere fai-aita te guruya waha, longi adai tafagu. Tere fai-aita ila adai dunege kote wagu. Tere adai yebu wagu.’” Tere fai-aita bagu ila beele yaawawou la, kot langa adai tafa nigagu. Tere anyatege ametege gane nebere huuna la yafa bonade, nebere beele oojo wagu.’
Ono wainga, mora bagu no benou letuwai, “Saini ji magana menakele la mai elebe, ji nuuni beele waha oruwa oojo wene.”

Ono wainga, Yesus no beele waha isidu bona mora bagu letuwai, “Ne dada etenga bona gai tutu hinina. Ne name dada oruwanga huurudu bonahe moni waha tedu, nere fai-aita dadanege uwau waha wese nagau. Ne onou ono bonahe wonga, ne ha laluwa la dada hilobainga tigini bagu. Onodu bonahe, ne mai ji oojo hiyau.”
Onowai wa, mora bagu no beele waha isidu bona, no huwanya ou dewai, taate bona, no dada baingaro bagu.
Yesus no mora bagu waha huwanya ou dewainga uredu bona benou lewai, “Nere fai dada baingaro waha, Itou nomo huuna langa yafou, waha huwanya la goyei nomo haruwe danga todbode.
Ariya, kamel no kolos ereregou niili yogodi langa goyei nomo wa ababiwou uwau. No moni fai, Itou nomo huuna langa yafou waha huwanya la goyei nomo ababina dorofe uwa.”
Ono wainga, nere fai beele waha isidu bode benou lewane, “Onou wa, faiwei no agege auma gai-gai hilobainga yafou waha edo langa tonbona?”
Ono wanenga, Yesus no lenigai, “Dada fai onowei nomo edo uwa waha, Itou no edo ono wonbona.”
Ono wainga Pita no lewai, “Isau. Ere ebere matane dada bagu awaruyaha ne oojo hiniya.”

Ono wainga Yesus no benou lenigai, “Ji tere ngalenga letigini, fai nere Itou nomo huuna langa yafou waha bode isidu, nere nebere mata bagu, oyanege gane bagu, bainege gane bagu, amenege anyanege gane bagu, magana bagu awa nigide waha,

saini nere oula beha langa yafa gogunga, Itou no dada elebe nere bagu inyina waha feiyadu baingaro nigonbona. Onodu saini iinga huunta heigona waha langa, nere agenege auma gai-gai hilobainga yafou waha todbode.”
Yesus no umedu ege gidu jayonbona, waha le eei wai.

Yesus no nomo disaipel 12, hanigedu bona lenigai, “Tere isagu. Elebe ere Jerusalem goyo boya. Nere profet amina beele oruwanga, Fai Nomo Idau langa dada heigonbona yeregane waha, elebe tigini heigonbona.
Nere no fai fereha owonege langa tafa tuwodbode. Ono wogunga, nere no memesi tubode, inyabamu tubode, bisinga tuwodbode.
Onodu nere no gula tudu bode, dukote wogunga umonbona. Ono wogunga fati eei langa no ege gidu jayonbona.”
Ariya nomo disaipel nere beele waha nomo hugu ada iside. Taate bona, beele waha nomo hugu huwarimu nigainga, nere no beele lewai waha bode fo nigi dewei uwa.
Yesus no fai ete ago fosokowou, jigemu tuwai.
Saini Yesus no mai Jeriko taon jugu gainga, fai ete ago fosokowou no jala hinemu la yafa bona, fai-aita bagu moni dada bona malagau nigai.
Ono gainga, nere fai-aita toomaro golodu mai ganenga isidu bona, no fai benou isoki nigai, “Nere taate adade?”
Ono wainga, nere letuwane, “Yesus Nasaretha golowaha maina.”
Ono wanenga, no yauredu letuwai, “Yesus, ne Devit Idau, ne ji bonahe augamu hinou.”
Ono wainga, nere fai amugedu mayane waha, nere honggoro tubode letuwane, “Ne hurate fosokowau.” Ono gane uwa, fai waha no ege-ege yaurenga bona lengawai, “Ne Devit Idau, ne ji bonahe augami hinou.”
Ono wainga, Yesus no maidu oto bona, fai waha haudu no bagu mayei nomo bona lenigai. Saini no mai jugu tuwainga, Yesus no benou isoki tuwai,
“Ji ne adadu ono hinei nomo gau hinina?” Ono wainga no letuwai, “Anyakaro, ji agefe igeiwei nomo gau hina.”
Ono wainga Yesus no letuwai, “Name agene edo hilou wona. Ne name huwanyate ngalengawou waha weenga, jigemu hinaha.”

Ono wainga fasadu onou, nomo ago jige tuwainga, no ege igeiwai. Onodu no Yesus oojo tudu goi bona, Itou unyi isouwai. Ono wainga, nere fai-aita bagu oruwanga waha uredu bode, nere fere Itou unyi isou wane.
